title: Full-colour FDM
description: I am connecting textured model data, printer coordination and cartridge timing into one colour-deposition pipeline.

title: Measurement & control
description: I use optical, force and temperature measurements to replace guesswork with feedback that a machine can act on.

title: Compact embedded devices
description: I keep reducing complete interactions until they fit on small boards without losing their physical clarity.

title: Manufacturing automation
description: I standardise feeders, tool changes and moving electrical systems so machines are easier to assemble and operate.

title: Configurable displays
description: I separate rendering and content from the screens that present them, from e-paper panels to a forty-client signage network.

title: Interactive software
description: I prototype multiplayer, procedural and economy-driven games with enough structure to survive beyond the original prompt.

title: Iterative PCB design
description: I treat connector fit, assembly effort and failed power choices as design inputs for the next revision.
